name: The Overlord, far off
description: the Overlord of Hell seen far away: a giant figure of black obsidian with a crown of long black horns, burning red eyes, broad shoulders under a heavy cloak of black stone, tired posture, lit only by lava glow from below

poses.stand: standing in profile facing right, cloak hanging, one hand resting on the horn of his crown, looking up

idle.action: stands still, his shoulders rising and falling slowly, his red eyes glowing, the cloak stirring
